test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a round table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). P is sitting to the immediate right of U and immediate left of S. S is sitting to the immediate left of T. Q is sitting to the immediate right of T and immediate left of R. Who is sitting to the immediate right of R?
solution: Given: P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a round table facing the centre​ 1) P is sitting to the immediate right of U and immediate left of S. 2) S is sitting to the immediate left of T.
